sketch.name: GridBoard
sketch.description: A dashboard board: section tabs, an edit toggle and a widget catalog over a 12-column grid whose widgets host real Wisej controls and can be dragged, resized, collapsed, recoloured and removed.

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of grid columns in the widest layout.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Height of one grid row, in pixels.

props.name: editMode
props.description: Widgets can be dragged and resized; the grid backdrop shows.

props.name: showToolbar
props.description: Shows the section tabs and the Edit layout / Add widget buttons.

props.name: selectedSection
props.description: Id of the section whose widgets show.

props.name: selected
props.description: Id of the selected widget (sketch only; the control tracks it on the client).

props.name: sections
props.description: The board's sections, shown as tabs.

props.name: catalog
props.description: The kinds of widget Add widget offers.

props.name: widgets
props.description: Sketch only: stands for the GridWidget child controls (ItemId, Section, Chrome, Title, Icon, Color, Buttons, GridX/Y/W/H, Collapsed).

sketch.notes: Parts plan (10): GridBoard (container control: toolbar, grid, server-side layout with GridKrafter.Core GridEngine/BoardArranger); GridWidget (container panel child: ItemId, Kind, Section, Title, Icon, Color, Chrome, Buttons, GridX/Y/W/H, Min/Max, Collapsed, AutoHeight, RefreshInterval; designer-placeable, body editable); GridWidgetChrome enum (Card, Plain); GridBoardSection + GridBoardSectionCollection; GridWidgetKind + GridWidgetKindCollection; GridBoardChangedEventArgs (Kind, ItemId, SectionId, Layout), GridBoardLayoutEventArgs (Breakpoint, Columns), GridWidgetEventArgs (Widget), GridWidgetKindEventArgs (Kind), GridBoardSectionAddingEventArgs (CancelEventArgs + Title); client class wisej.web.GridBoard.js (toolbar, edit backdrop, drag/resize placeholder, widget chrome DOM over child controls); theme mixin (colours from theme names: window, controlText, border, highlight, plus gridboard palette colours). Buttons reuse GridKrafter.Models.WidgetButtons. Breakpoints: 12 cols >=1100 px, 6 >=768 (task) / 1 below 480; widgets lay out server-side as child control bounds; collapse = header only; fullscreen = one widget fills the board.
